packages.exception_rationale_and_limits: Owned certificate ASN.1 parsing; src/lib.rs forbids unsafe; BER parser default recursion 50. Parser correctness and arbitrary malformed input are not fully audited.
Compiler procedural macro for ASN.1 derives; inspected token parsing/emission has no external I/O or process execution. Generated semantics are not formally proved.

Compiler procedural macro encodes fixed OID/integer token literals; no external I/O/process found. Compile-time input handling is not a complete macro audit. Declares MIT OR Apache-2.0 but packages no standalone license text; retain this provenance qualification.
RMCP async interface procedural macro; token AST to boxed future expansion, no external I/O/process found; generated lifetime/Send behavior not fully audited.
Hyper wake coordination; atomic state guards unsafe interior-cell access and Send/Sync; callback panic/concurrency behavior not formally proved. Retain LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.
PEM/HTTP encoding; default features include simd-unsafe. Inspected AVX2/NEON dispatch and unchecked encoding operations; no autonomous I/O/process. No all-architecture SIMD soundness claim.
ASN.1 bit strings; bitmap indexing/allocation source inspected; no autonomous I/O/process found. Resource limits remain caller responsibility.
Certificate data encoding; unsafe slice chunking/UTF8 views rely on checked bounds/alphabet contracts. No autonomous I/O/process found; no complete soundness proof.

Certificate DER/BER parser; forbids unsafe and default recursion 50. ber/tagged.rs explicitly resets a depth counter and ignores trailing bytes in one generic combinator; not a universal recursion/completeness guarantee. Native owned certificate files are separately bounded.
Certificate time bounded integer helpers; unsafe unchecked constructors/range assumptions inspected; no autonomous I/O/process found. Range-contract correctness not fully proved.
Ring OS entropy; unsafe OS FFI, Linux /dev/urandom fallback; no downloader/subprocess found. Other target/custom/JS/RDRAND paths are not platform-qualified.
Canonical HTTP types; unsafe header-map/byte representations. HeaderValue sensitivity is opt-in, not default credential redaction. Packaged VCS dirty flag retained.
HTTP streaming trait; unsafe pin projections; size hints are not enforced budgets. Packaged VCS dirty flag retained.
Bounded HTTP body adapters; Limited checks frame bytes, plain collect accumulates without its own cap. Unsafe pin projection inspected; callers must retain explicit limits.
HTTP/1 parser with unsafe cursors/SIMD; build script runs configured RUSTC --version and emits cfgs, no download. No complete parser/request-smuggling/all-target soundness audit.
Hyper date formatting/parsing; forbids unsafe, no autonomous I/O/process found. Not a general calendar validation audit.
Native HTTP/1 transport; caller-provided I/O/executor. Unsafe read buffers/upgrades/wakers; caller TLS/auth/budgets/deadlines retained. Optional HTTP2/C FFI not qualified.
Tokio I/O adapter with unsafe ReadBuf projection. Optional legacy DNS/socket/proxy-environment paths exist; direct declaration selects tokio. Unified feature graph not executed.
Parser shared initialization; Once/MaybeUninit unsafe publication inspected, no autonomous I/O/process found. User initializer behavior is outside this crate's guarantee.
ASN.1 arbitrary precision integers; unsafe ASCII/UTF8 conversion and CPU arithmetic intrinsics inspected. Not constant-time crypto assurance; caller allocation limits remain required.
Time integer conversions; pure arithmetic/traits, no external I/O/process or unsafe found in inspected source. No exhaustive arithmetic proof.
Certificate OID names; build script reads packaged assets/oid_db.txt and writes OUT_DIR/oid_db.rs. No subprocess/download; fixed verified archive DB is a compiler input. Runtime forbids unsafe.
Owned CA PEM armor; pure parse/encode, no unsafe/external I/O/process found in inspected source. Decoding is not certificate trust validation.
Time formatting; unsafe MaybeUninit buffers rely on initialized width/precision contracts. No autonomous I/O/process found; full soundness not proved.

Owner-private CA/leaf issuance using ring SystemRandom; forbids unsafe, no build script. Issuer CA parser assumes rather than validates CA. Private key DER clones are not automatically zeroized; optional zeroize omitted by AIRK.

TLS cryptography and OS entropy via Rust/C/ASM FFI and CPU dispatch. Build script executes compiler/assembler, can consume shipped pregenerated objects, optional regeneration Perl/NASM; no download found. Packaged dirty VCS metadata and nested Apache/ISC notices retained; no crypto/prebuilt reproducibility audit.
ASN.1 parser combinator macros; inspected source has no unsafe/autonomous I/O/process. Composed parser completeness/resource bounds remain caller responsibilities.

TLS engine, forbids unsafe, ring/WebPKI delegation; build script probes optional nightly cfg. Explicit KeyLogFile can read SSLKEYLOGFILE/write secrets; AIRK must not install logger. No protocol/crypto correctness certification.
TLS key/certificate/name containers; explicit caller PEM file APIs and fixed-layout unsafe IPv6 conversion. Zeroization is API-specific, not all copies. No independent trust validation in types.

TLS chain and identity validation with explicit work budgets; no unsafe/autonomous I/O/process found in inspected source. Chain and name validation are separate caller obligations; no complete cryptographic/parser audit.
RMCP SSE parser; unfinished lines/event data grow without intrinsic byte bound; optional tracing logs invalid content. Exception conditional on caller byte/event/deadline limits and logging policy.
Constant-time selection helpers use unsafe volatile optimization barrier; no external I/O/process. Best-effort compiler barrier, not universal constant-time proof.
ASN.1 derive token AST helper; no external I/O/process or unsafe found in inspected source. Generated-code behavior not fully audited.

CA certificate validity intervals; private unsafe validated date/range operations. Optional local-offset has OS FFI; declared default std/macros are not full resolved feature proof. No autonomous process/download found.
Shared time/calendar constants and arithmetic; no unsafe/external I/O/process found in inspected source. No exhaustive calendar arithmetic proof.
Compiler-executed date/time literal macros; unsafe UTF8/slice and emitted unchecked validated constructors. No external I/O/process found; no full generated-code soundness proof.
Async TLS over caller-provided I/O, no autonomous dial/resolve; no unsafe/build script found. Caller owns deadlines, authorization, CA validation and cancellation.
Readiness/call trait, forbids unsafe; implementers must release admission reservations on cancellation. No independent scheduler/admission guarantee.

Checked bounded input reader/read_all rejects trailing input; no unsafe/build script/autonomous I/O/process found. Does not validate higher-level certificate semantics.

Hyper readiness uses checked try_lock_explicit SeqCst at both inspected calls, atomic state and caller wakers; no unsafe/external I/O found. Conditional on try-lock checked usage; no concurrency proof.
